intro.title: Toggle Visibility
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple Vue application that shows and hides content with a button click. You will learn how to use Vue's reactive data system to track whether content is visible. The main concepts you'll practice are conditional rendering with v-if and handling click events with v-on. By the end, you'll understand how to control UI visibility dynamically using Vue's reactivity.
intro.usecase: Toggling visibility is a core pattern in interactive web applications. You'll use it to show or hide form sections based on user input, expand and collapse detailed panels in dashboards, and manage dropdown menus or modal dialogs. Mastering this concept allows you to build dynamic, user-friendly interfaces that respond instantly to user actions.
